column1: # Chinese grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# Words are written traditional first, then their simplified spelling after
# a `/` (還/还): both are the word's lemma, and the headword shows the one the
# text uses first. A line comes before Wiktionary's entries for the word,
# which are mostly a character's whole page, in Wiktionary's order (的 opens
# on "bright; clear"); content words stay after it.
# Lines are for a word's common grammatical uses, which a character's page
# lists late or not at all. See apps/importer/src/grammar.ts.

column3: of, 's: links a describing word or phrase to the noun after it (我的書, my book; 紅色的花, red flowers) | the one(s) that: stands for a noun left out (新的, the new one; 賣菜的, someone who sells vegetables) | at the end of a sentence, stresses that something is so (我會去的, I will go, for sure) | 是…的: stresses when, where or how something happened (他是昨天來的, it was yesterday that he came)
after a verb: the action is done (我吃了飯, I ate) | at the end of a sentence: something has changed, or is now so (下雨了, it's raining now; 我懂了, I get it now) | 太…了: too…, so… (太好了, great!)
-ing: an action or state goes on (他笑著說, he said, smiling; 門開著, the door is open)
after a verb: have (ever) done (我去過北京, I have been to Beijing)
-ly: makes an adverb of the word before it (慢慢地走, walk slowly; 認真地學習, study seriously)
after a verb or adjective, says how or how much (他跑得很快, he runs fast; 累得不想動, so tired one doesn't want to move) | 得 between a verb and its result: can (看得見, can see; 聽得懂, can understand)
makes a yes-or-no question (你好嗎?, how are you?; 你是學生嗎?, are you a student?)
and…?, what about…? (我很好, 你呢?, I'm fine, and you?) | softens a question (你在做什麼呢?, what are you doing?) | an action going on (他在睡覺呢, he's sleeping)
let's, suggests or asks softly (我們走吧, let's go; 你來吧, come on) | I suppose, right?: guesses (你是老師吧?, you're a teacher, right?)
ah, oh: 啊 after a vowel, softens or stresses what is said (好呀, OK!; 快來呀, come on!) | after each item of a list, in speech
at the end of a sentence: ah, oh, softens or stresses what is said (好啊, OK!; 真漂亮啊, so beautiful!) | after each item of a list, or a pause in speech (這個啊, 我也不知道, as for this, I don't know either)
stresses what is obvious: after all, you know (這是應該的嘛, that's how it should be, after all) | marks a pause before what follows
plural of people and pronouns (我們, we; 朋友們, friends)

still, yet (他還在睡, he is still asleep; 還沒, not yet) | also, in addition, too (我還想喝茶, I'd also like some tea) | even more (今天比昨天還冷, today is even colder than yesterday) | fairly, passably (還不錯, not bad; 還好, all right)

right away, then (我馬上就來, I'll come right away; 說完就走了, left as soon as (he) had spoken) | just, exactly, precisely (就是他, it's him; 就在這裡, right here) | only, just (就一個, just one) | then, in that case (要是你去, 我就去, if you go, then I'll go)
only then, not until (他十點才來, he didn't come until ten) | only, just (才五塊錢, only five yuan) | just now (我才知道, I've only just found out)
all, both (我們都是學生, we are all students) | already (都十點了, it's already ten o'clock) | even (連他都知道, even he knows)
also, too (我也去, I'm going too) | 也不, 也沒: (not) either, (not) even (一點也不累, not tired at all)
again (他又來了, he came again) | and also, both… and… (又便宜又好, both cheap and good)
again, once more (in the future) (再說一遍, say it again; 再見, goodbye) | then, after that (吃完飯再走, leave after eating)
very, quite; also links an adjective to its subject without adding much (他很高, he is tall)
too (太貴了, too expensive) | so, very (太好了, great!)
most, -est (最好, best; 最重要, most important)
more, even more (更好, better; 更重要的是, what's more important)
already (他已經走了, he has already left)
in the middle of, -ing (我正在吃飯, I'm eating)
in the middle of, -ing: before a verb (他在看書, he is reading)
not, no (不是, is not; 不好, not good) | 不…不…: neither…nor; 不得不: have to
not (in the past), have not (我沒去, I didn't go; 還沒吃, haven't eaten yet)
don't (別說話, don't talk; 別擔心, don't worry)
together (我們一起去吧, let's go together)
always, all along, continuously (他一直在等, he has been waiting all along) | straight (一直走, go straight ahead)
only, just (我只有一個, I only have one; 只是, it's only that)
越…越…: the more… the more… (越來越好, better and better; 越快越好, the faster the better)
in, inside: after a noun (房間裡, in the room; 城市裡, in the city; 心裡, in one's heart)
in, among, during: after a noun (生活中, in life; 學生中, among the students; 一年中, during the year)
on, above: after a noun (桌子上, on the table) | in, in terms of (網上, online; 歷史上, in history; 實際上, in fact)
under, below: after a noun (桌子下, under the table) | 在…下: under (the conditions of) (在他的幫助下, with his help)
inside, within: after a noun (國內, within the country; 三天內, within three days)
outside, beyond: after a noun (國外, abroad; 門外, outside the door) | 以外, 之外: besides, other than
at, in, on: where something is or happens (在家, at home; 在中國, in China; 在這方面, in this respect)
puts the object before the verb, to say what is done to it (把門關上, close the door; 把書給我, give me the book)
by: makes a verb passive (他被老師批評了, he was criticised by the teacher)
to, for (給他打電話, call him; 給你看, show you)
to, towards, about (對我很好, kind to me; 對這個問題, about this question)
with (跟朋友去, go with friends) | 跟…一樣: the same as | and (我跟你, you and I)
and (我和你, you and I; 書和筆, books and pens)
and, with (formal) (老師與學生, teachers and students)
from (從北京來, come from Beijing; 從今天開始, starting today)
towards, to (向東走, walk east; 向他學習, learn from him)
towards, to (往前走, walk forward; 往左, to the left)
for, for the sake of (為你高興, happy for you) | 為了: in order to
with, by means of, as (以…為主, mainly…; 以前, before; 以後, after) | in order to (formal)
at, in, on (formal) (位於北京, located in Beijing; 於2020年, in 2020) | than, to: after an adjective or verb (大於, greater than; 屬於, belong to)
puts the object before the verb, as 把 does (formal) (將水燒開, bring the water to the boil)
will, be going to (formal) (會議將在明天舉行, the meeting will be held tomorrow)
than: compares (他比我高, he is taller than me)
and, and also: joins verbs or clauses (formal) (討論並通過, discussed and passed)
並不, 並沒有: not at all, actually not (並不難, not hard at all)
and, but, while: joins two clauses or words (formal) (快而好, fast and good; 不是…而是…, not… but…)
but (很好, 但是太貴, good, but too expensive)
but (我想去, 可是沒時間, I want to go, but I have no time)
so, therefore (下雨了, 所以我沒去, it rained, so I didn't go)
because (因為下雨, 我沒去, because it rained, I didn't go)
if (如果你有時間, if you have time)
although (雖然很累, 但是很高興, though tired, happy)
or (in statements) (茶或者咖啡, tea or coffee)
or (in questions) (你喝茶還是咖啡?, tea or coffee?)
still, all the same (他還是來了, he came all the same) | had better (你還是去吧, you'd better go)
if: ends an if-clause (下雨的話, 我就不去, if it rains, I won't go)
to be: links a subject to what it is (我是學生, I am a student) | yes, right | 是…的: stresses when, where or how something happened
can, know how to (我會游泳, I can swim) | will, be likely to (明天會下雨, it will rain tomorrow)
can, be able to (我能來, I can come) | may, be allowed to
can, may (我可以進來嗎?, may I come in?) | not bad (還可以, OK, so-so)
want to (我要回家, I want to go home) | will, be going to (要下雨了, it's going to rain) | must, should (你要小心, you must be careful)
want to, would like to (我想喝水, I'd like some water)
should, ought to (你應該休息, you should rest)
děi: must, have to (我得走了, I have to go)
to have (我有一個問題, I have a question) | there is, there are (這裡有很多人, there are many people here)
to let, to make (someone do something) (讓我想想, let me think; 讓他高興, make him happy)
this (這是我的, this is mine; 這個, this one; 這裡, here)
that (那是什麼?, what is that?; 那個, that one; 那裡, there)
then, in that case (那我們走吧, then let's go)
which (哪個?, which one?; 哪裡, where)
what (你說什麼?, what did you say?) | any, anything (沒什麼, it's nothing) | before a list: things like, such as (in speech) (什麼咖啡、茶都有, there's coffee, tea, all sorts)
how (怎麼走?, how do I get there?) | why, how come (你怎麼不來?, why aren't you coming?)
how, how about it (你覺得怎麼樣?, what do you think?; 最近怎麼樣?, how have you been?)
why (你為什麼哭?, why are you crying?)
oneself, one's own (我自己做, I'll do it myself; 自己的房間, one's own room)
classifier for most nouns, people and things without a classifier of their own (一個人, one person; 三個蘋果, three apples; 這個, this one)
some, a few (一些, some; 這些, these; 那些, those)
kind, type, sort (這種書, this kind of book; 各種, all kinds of)
time, occurrence (一次, once; 第一次, the first time)
classifier for shops, companies and families (一家餐廳, a restaurant)
-th: makes an ordinal number (第一, first; 第三天, the third day)
very, extremely (非常好, very good; 非常感謝, thank you very much)
especially, particularly (特別是, especially; 特別喜歡, especially like)
of course, naturally (當然可以, of course you can)
but, however (不過我沒時間, but I have no time) | only, merely (不過是, only, just)
anyway, in any case (反正我不去, I'm not going anyway)
after a number: about, approximately, or so (三分鐘左右, about three minutes)
then, next, after that (接著放鹽, then add salt)
besides, apart from, other than (除了…以外, except for…; 中國以外, outside China)
respectively, separately, each (分別是, are respectively; 分別討論, discuss separately)
probably (他大概不來了, he probably isn't coming) | about, roughly (大概十個人, about ten people)
really, truly (真的很好, really good; 真的嗎?, really?)
someone, some people (有人說, some people say)
after a list: and so on, etc. (書、筆等, books, pens, etc.) | after names: and others, et al.
Taiwan: short for 臺灣 (來臺, come to Taiwan; 臺北, Taipei)
mm, uh-huh: agrees, or shows one is listening or thinking | mm: shows enjoyment
uh, er: a pause while thinking | hey: calls for attention
that is to say, in other words
that is to say, in other words
不好 + verb: hard to, not easy to (不好說, hard to say) | not good
in fact, actually
after a verb: a moment, a little, to soften a request (看一下, have a look; 等一下, wait a moment)
